---
name: conductor-setup
description: Scaffolds the Conductor SDD environment and initializes project context.
---

Initialize the Conductor Spec-Driven Development (SDD) framework in the current project:
1. Audit the directory for existing code and dependencies (Greenfield vs. Brownfield).
2. Establish `conductor/product.md`, `conductor/product-guidelines.md`, `conductor/tech-stack.md`, and `conductor/workflow.md`.
3. Copy relevant coding style guides into `conductor/code_styleguides/`.
4. Create the project handshake index in `conductor/index.md`.
5. Stage and commit: `chore(conductor): Initialize project context and standards`.
